messages.content: Hi there, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's treating you alright. Anything new to share — readings, symptoms, how the meds have been going?
Got a headache that started this morning and won't let up. Took my pressure a bit ago and it came back 178 over 112. Feeling kind of foggy.
I'm logging that reading right now. I want to make sure I have the full picture — are you having any chest tightness, shortness of breath, or changes in your vision along with that headache?
Yeah there's some pressure in my chest. Not sharp or anything but it's been sitting there a couple hours. Vision seems fine.

Thank you for telling me that. I'm flagging this for a nurse right now. I want to be straight with you — the median response time is currently 31 hours. I'm not able to give you medical advice, but please don't wait on us if this gets worse. Chest tightness with a reading that high is something where 911 is the right call if you feel unsafe before the nurse reaches you.
31 hours is a long time out here. Any way to get a ride arranged to a clinic or something?

I really do understand — 31 hours is a long time and being far from a clinic makes it harder. I'm not able to arrange transport; that's not something I can do yet, and I'm sorry for that gap. If you feel like this is becoming an emergency, 911 is the way to go — don't hold off on that. I'm going to set your next check-in for tomorrow morning so we can follow up on how you're doing.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
